summary: This filing is a routine current report on Form 6-K by Metalla Royalty & Streaming Ltd. It announces the release of the company's 2026 Asset Handbook and an annual letter to shareholders. There is no mention of any transaction such as an acquisition, divestiture, strategic review, or other special situation. The news release provides an overview of the company's royalty portfolio and business strategy, but does not report any event that would classify it as a special situation. The filing is informational and forward-looking in nature.
